name: revisar-pr-bitbucket
description: Reviews Bitbucket pull requests against three questions only — does it fix the YouTrack ticket, does it break something in or out of scope (database included), does it open a security hole — then applies the verdict: comment + request changes when it needs work, approve (never merge) when it doesn't. Includes corrigir-pr, a fixer that resolves the reviewer's findings on a local copy of the branch before the dev is asked for changes.
